You are travelling for tourism, business meetings, transit or to visit family or friends

sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Djibouti visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Djibouti, and can apply online for an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: Djibouti visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. The eVisa approval must match the passport you travel with.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Djibouti
sections.text: Read the latest UK government travel advice for Djibouti before you book, and have your hotel booking and return flight ready, as they may be checked on arrival.

sections.heading: Djibouti visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Djibouti visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Djibouti.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Djibouti from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens can apply online for a Djibouti eVisa before travelling.

faqs.q: How long does a Djibouti visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Djibouti visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Djibouti visa application and submit it for you.
